parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint under the decision rules regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The duplicate 'DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator.next' in 'DebugHUD.swift' is almost certainly a local debug convenience copy written to support the sample app's own HUD, not a production type. Extracting the shared implementation into a common location would couple the production 'DebugPanel' package to sample-app demonstration semantics, which is the canonical anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
